remaining.detail: The required ws package could not load, so two test files did not reach behavioral checks. No dependency was installed.

remaining.name: Five helper-dependent checks
remaining.detail: Three static helper executables could not link with the available MinGW runtime. A full baseline native build was not performed.

remaining.name: 22 safety-held registrations
remaining.detail: Held for foreground/input, real media, source or registry mutation, uncertain service ownership, or optional-host isolation. They are not passes or skips.

remaining.name: Earlier combined checks
remaining.detail: A previous 23/24 run retained a baseline wording assertion failure. That aggregate was not rerun without sufficient service-isolation evidence.

remaining.name: Real-use and release checks
remaining.detail: Actual-model recall, physical desktop, voice/media/GPU, integration, release and deployment remain unqualified. No performance improvement is claimed.
